messages:
Ari: Morning crisis: someone scorched the office toaster and now it only produces 'charcoal artisan slices'. Who is the culprit?
Ben: That was me. I attempted sourdough aventuring. 0/10 would not recommend. Sorry.
Zoe: It had to be ritual-level toasting. We need a Toast Tribunal.
Gabe: I propose "Toast of the Week" award to be given to the best (or most dramatic) toast. Winner gets a golden toothpick.
Ari: We should also require a post-toast writeup: bread type, temperature setting, and a one-line tragedy/haiku.
SnackBot: Poll created: "Toast of the Week format" 91 react with :one: (award) :two: (tribunal) :three: (ban toaster).
Ben: I volunteer as inaugural performer, accepting full responsibility and texture critique.
Zoe: Safety update: unplug toaster after use. Also new sign: "No sourdough experiments before coffee."
Gabe: Can we engrave the golden toothpick with the phrase "Crisped but loved"?
Ari: Also idea: a tiny shrine of saved crumbs for future offerings. Please add tasteful LED candles.
SnackBot: Reminder: kitchen policy update draft posted in #help. TL;DR: treat appliances like living things.
Ben: I'll make amends with donuts tomorrow. Plus an apology haiku: "Bread met iron heat / Dreams of crunch turned midnight ash / Sorry for the smoke."
Zoe: Accepted. Donuts will be judged by the Toast Tribunal for restorative justice.
Gabe: Long live crunchy repentance.
